question: The Regulation on Deforestation-Free Products1 seeks to promote the consumption of ‘deforestationfree’ products, which include grain imports to Member States. 1.
Is the Commission aware of any requests for a derogation to this Regulation to allow companies to continue to import grain from locations that are not specifically deforestation-free?
If there have been requests for derogation, what advice has the Commission provided on the matter, and what reporting mechanisms are in place to oversee the implementation of this Regulation?

Regulation (EU) 2023/1115 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 31 May 2023 on the making available on the Union market and the export from the Union of certain commodities and products associated with deforestation and forest degradation and repealing Regulation (EU) No 995/2010 (OJ L 150, 9.6.2023, p. 206).
answer: The regulation on Deforestation-Free Products (2) applies to the placing on the market of seven commodities and certain derived products. Grain imports are not within its scope. Article 22 of the regulation provides for annual reports by Member States on the application of the regulation and for the Commission services to provide annual overviews of its application.
